title: 原生工程多页视图与分幅输出
execution: Use public MCP on a portable saved MPJ. Each page reuses the original native project renderer; Ghostscript assembles the checked EPS pages. No desktop input.
validation_scope: An original eight-layer report window printed as three explicit views with unchanged scale, ordered PDF pages, EPS/PNG/300dpi TIFF, XLSX/CSV index and relocated editable MPJ.16 actual workflow calls,15 recovery calls after exits107/108/109;59 related tests. This is not a proprietary native multi-page layout format or complete page-object/printer support.
inputs: 原生工程及同目录依赖；工程系统库副本与绑定摘要
每页唯一名称、原生坐标范围、实际纸张毫米尺寸和页序
显式输出dpi和是否需要TIFF；打印页不自动赋地理坐标

steps.action: Bind the saved MPJ and inspect layer order/state/display limits, native bounds and system library. Use a portable project with sibling dependencies.
checks: 原生坐标单位和项目环境
图层状态与显示比例限制

steps.action: Pass explicitly ordered pages with unique names and existing native view schema. Each page draws the same saved project at its declared extent/paper size. Page names label the index; add native title/page graphics in the source when needed.
checks: PDF实际页数、页序、纸张尺寸和逐页像素对照
可选TIFF尺寸、样本和DPI元数据
原生保存工程副本与全部依赖

steps.action: Read pages.xlsx/图幅 through the existing XLSX API, reopen the copied MPJ and verify all dependencies resolve inside its output folder. series.json retains exact views and hashes; pages.csv is also available for plain-data consumers.
checks: 工程可迁移重开，图层和文件内容相同
最终图件可见、图面关系正确

steps.action: Inspect the existing request after interruption. Adopt completed native page plots and a committed combined PDF, then continue only not-yet-issued pages and necessary format conversion. Changed source, frozen context/index/TIFF or PDF is rejected.
checks: 已完成原生页PID/PS/日志/摘要与mtime保持
恢复页PNG/TIFF与不中断基准一致
